summary: Electrovaya Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a routine current report) furnishing a press release announcing its fourth-place ranking among Enterprise Industry Leaders in Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50 program. The release cites four-year revenue growth of 354% and notes this is Electrovaya's fourth consecutive appearance and second in the Enterprise category, which requires at least $10 million of 2021 revenue and $50 million of 2025 revenue. No transaction, capital event, or governance change is disclosed; the only forward-looking item is the planned Jamestown, New York manufacturing expansion. No deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle exists.
